correctness.rationale: The graph-edge commutator implies proportional nonzero tuple columns on active induced components. The linear conjugation map has independent internal-edge and crossing-edge contributions of ranks |U|-c(U) and |N[U]\U|, respectively. Every orbit has size q^r and each central-coordinate fiber contributes q^(k|E|-r) orbits. Exhaustive finite group multiplication, conjugacy and independent rank experiments corroborate exact predictions.

value.rationale: A complete orbit-size polynomial for all commuting tuple arities and all finite graphical groups is a structural, natural invariant, not merely a total number or special graph table. It identifies active induced-component projective data and their conjugation rank, and explicitly separates two equal-order groups with identical ordinary class numbers by higher simultaneous orbits.
